_notes: Knowledge Forge Phase 5 — Claude Code hook bindings (DESIGN §13, ADDENDUM §C).
Nothing in this repo merges this file into ~/.claude/settings.json or a project's
own .claude/settings.json automatically — that install step is a known, recorded
packaging gap (same class as the root-level agents/ gap CLAUDE.md already notes),
closed only once Phase 6's plugin manifest lands. Until then, copy the four entries
under "hooks" below into the target settings.json's own "hooks" object by hand.
Resume gotcha: SessionStart re-runs on --continue/--resume (with source: resume) —
that's expected, forge session-context's output is idempotent and cheap to re-print.
But every OTHER hook's output on a resumed session is REPLAYED from the saved
transcript text, not re-executed. So nothing time-sensitive belongs in
UserPromptSubmit (or any hook here) — a stale recall hit from the original session is
expected on resume, not a bug in forge intent.
